name: Nagyrécse (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner with diagonal stripes of blue and yellow, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Nagyrécse: a quartered blue and green shield with a cross, a plough, a tree and a bunch of grapes, with red mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
